mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.title, p.emotion, p.emotion_label, p.content, p.images, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.source, p.source_diary_id, p.is_deleted, p.create_time, p.update_time, u.nickname as authorNickname, u.avatar_url as authorAvatar FROM post p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.create_time DESC

SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.title, p.emotion, p.emotion_label, p.content, p.images, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.source, p.source_diary_id, p.is_deleted, p.create_time, p.update_time, u.nickname as authorNickname, u.avatar_url as authorAvatar FROM post p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{id}
